info.name: WorkSphere API
info.description: Employee Management System API. Cookie-based JWT auth (httpOnly) — run Auth > Login first, Postman's cookie jar carries the session for every request after that automatically. Set the `employeeId` collection variable to any employee's _id to use the :id routes below (copy one from a List/Create response).

request.description: Public. Sets an httpOnly `token` cookie on success — Postman's cookie jar stores it automatically, no manual copy needed. Response body includes mustChangePassword; if true, every other route except /me, /change-password, and /logout 403s until change-password is called.
Requires a logged-in cookie, no role restriction. Returns the same shape Login does. Works even while mustChangePassword is true — a frontend needs this to learn that fact in the first place.
Requires a logged-in cookie. Clears mustChangePassword so other routes unblock. newPassword min 8 chars.
Clears the token cookie. Works even while mustChangePassword is true.
super_admin or hr_manager only. salary is included for both roles here (employees can't reach this route at all).

super_admin or hr_manager only. hr_manager cannot set role to super_admin (403). role defaults to "employee" if omitted. department: Engineering | Design | Product | Sales | Marketing | HR | Finance. phone: 10-15 digits, optional leading +. password min 8 chars, becomes the temp password (mustChangePassword defaults true). employeeId is server-generated (EMP-0001...) — do not send it, response includes it.

super_admin/hr_manager can view anyone. employee can only view their own record (403 otherwise) and never sees salary on it — salary only appears for super_admin/hr_manager. 404 if not found or soft-deleted.

All fields optional, send only what changes. super_admin: anyone, any field including role. hr_manager: anyone except a Super Admin's record (403), and can't set role to super_admin (403). employee: own record only, and only name/phone/profileImage are actually applied — anything else sent (including role) is silently dropped, not rejected. employeeId, password, mustChangePassword can never be set here.
super_admin only (403 for hr_manager and employee). Soft delete — sets isDeleted:true, deletedAt:<now>. Document stays in Mongo, just disappears from List/GetById/Reportees/Tree.

Returns employees whose reportingManager equals :id. super_admin/hr_manager can check anyone's; employee can only check their own (403 for anyone else's id). Salary still hidden when the requester is an employee, even for their own reports.

super_admin or hr_manager only (403 for employee, including changing their own). Set reportingManager to an employee _id or null to clear it. Rejects (400) if the proposed manager doesn't exist or is soft-deleted, or if the assignment would create a circular reporting chain — including setting an employee as their own manager directly.

super_admin or hr_manager only. Returns the full reporting structure nested from every employee with reportingManager: null (there can be more than one root). Each node: employeeId, name, designation, department, role, children.

super_admin or hr_manager only. Returns totalEmployees, activeEmployees, inactiveEmployees (on_leave counts active, only terminated counts inactive), and departmentCounts (every department in the enum, zero-filled).
